Subject: Pricing & Stakeholder Alignment — Finex pilot (token volumes and budget)

Hi Sara — great conversation today, thanks for walking through the pilot goals. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align pricing and procurement next week:

Summary of what we agreed on the call:
- Pilot scope: 3-month pilot focused on customer-facing summarization and search-ranking. ~10M tokens/month initial pilot, expectation to scale to 200–300M tokens/month if pilot meets targets; longer-term (12 months) forecast discussed in the 300M–1B tokens/month range.
- Readouts: success metrics are latency < 350ms 95th, summary quality > baseline, and < $/1M tokens target to keep unit economics positive for your model.

Pricing & unit-econ items we discussed (rough figures for alignment):
- Hosted (on-demand) indicative price: $30 / 1M tokens (list, small pilot discount possible)
- Committed / Dedicated (reserved capacity) indicative: $15–$20 / 1M tokens depending on commitment length and burst policy
- Example math: at 200M tokens/month -> hosted ~ $6,000/month (200 * $30/1M) vs dedicated ~ $3,000–$4,000/month.

Asks / decisions needed from Finex so we can finalize an MLP (mutual action plan) and pricing attachment:
1) Confirm economic buyer (who will sign off on the overall spend / deal).
2) Confirm finance approver / PO owner (who will handle the procurement paperwork).
3) Confirm the budget range for the pilot (ballpark is helpful — e.g., <$10k/month, $10–$50k/month, >$50k/month).
4) Any constraints on contract term or required SLAs (e.g., region, data residency).

I attached an updated pricing sheet and the mutual action plan draft for your review. If you can confirm items 1–3 this week, we can send a pilot SOW and PO path for finance to review and target a start in early December.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sara/Rajiv: Confirm economic buyer + finance approver + budget band by Fri EOD (13 Nov)
- Aditya/Rishi: Provide one-page dedicated capacity options & exact seat/burst costs by 12 Nov
- Marissa: Draft pilot SOW and send over pricing sheet + MAP (attached)

Thanks — look forward to locking this down.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Looping in a quick pricing breakdown / unit-econ examples so everyone has the same numbers. This mirrors the attached PDF but called out inline for Leah and Rajiv:

Assumptions: 
- Token definition: 1M tokens ~ typical for ~750–800 pages of content (approx).
- Pilot volumes: 10M/month (initial) -> expected 200M/month within 6–12 months if successful.

Indicative pricing (not final contract):
1) Hosted (on-demand): $30 / 1M tokens
   - 10M/month -> $300/month
   - 200M/month -> $6,000/month
2) Dedicated (reserved capacity / committed): $15 / 1M tokens (6–12 month commitment recommended)
   - 200M/month -> $3,000/month
3) Hybrid (prefix caching + burst to hosted): typical effective rate ~$18–$22 / 1M tokens depending on cache hit rate

If Leah needs a one-page procurement sheet: I can produce a compact vendor pricing table + invoice contact details. Also, for Dedicated we'd want a 6-month minimum to guarantee capacity; we can include a pilot-specific ramp clause.

Marissa — do we have standard W-9 + vendor onboarding docs to attach to the MAP for Leah?

- Aditya (Solutions Engineer, Redwood)
